AsBuild:
(fn AsBuild ()
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams))
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEye (Math|Transform|TransformLocation (Transformation|GetActorTransform) (Variables|4-Fuente|GetPreviewEye)))
  (CallFunction|AsEmitUpdate)
  (bind now (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeinSeconds))
  (bind emitl (Math|Transform|InverseTransformLocation (Transformation|GetActorTransform) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmitW)))
  (for i (range (Variables|1-Chorros|GetMaxStreams))
    (bind c (AddComponent|Common|AddStaticMeshComponent :bManualAttachment false :RelativeTransform (Math|Transform|MakeTransform :Location (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X 0.0 :Y 0.0 :Z 0.0))))
    (Components|StaticMesh|SetStaticMesh c (Variables|3-Luz|GetMoteMesh))
    (Rendering|Material|SetMaterial c 0 (Variables|3-Luz|GetMoteMat))
    (Collision|SetCollisionEnabled c "NoCollision")
    (Rendering|SetCastShadow c false)
    (Utilities|Array|Add (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams) c)
    (CallFunction|AsLook :Comp c)
    (bind hue (+ 20.0 (* 47.0 (Math|Conversions|ToFloat(Integer) i))))
    (CallFunction|AsStart :Comp c :T0 (- now 600.0) :Col (Math|Color|HSVtoRGB hue 0.55 1.0 1.0) :Seed hue)
    (CallFunction|AsPlace :Comp c :EyeL (Variables|4-Fuente|GetPreviewEye) :EmitL emitl)
    (Rendering|SetVisibility c (< i (Variables|5-Prueba|GetPreviewStreams)) false)))
AsStart:
(fn AsStart (Comp T0 Col Seed)
  (bind (r g b a) (Utilities|Struct|BreakLinearColor Col))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 Comp 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 T0 Seed 0.0 0.0))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 Comp 4 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 r g b (Variables|3-Luz|GetColorPow)))
  (Rendering|SetVisibility Comp true false))
AsPlace:
(fn AsPlace (Comp EyeL EmitL)
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 Comp 8 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 (.x EyeL) (.y EyeL) (.z EyeL) (Variables|2-Envoltura|GetRadius)))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 Comp 12 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 (.x EmitL) (.y EmitL) (.z EmitL) (Variables|2-Envoltura|GetSquash))))
AsEmitUpdate:
(fn AsEmitUpdate ()
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind al (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)))
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmitW (+ al (* (Math|Vector|Normalize (- (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEye) al)) (Variables|4-Fuente|GetEmitOffset)))))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmitW (Math|Transform|TransformLocation (Transformation|GetActorTransform) (Variables|4-Fuente|GetNoAmoebaAt))))))
AsBoot:
(fn AsBoot ()
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetUsed 0)
  (for c (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams)
    (CallFunction|AsLook :Comp c)
    (Rendering|SetVisibility c false false))
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetNextDebug (+ (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeinSeconds) 2.0))
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetSeen (Class|BPHarpSC|GetLastPluck (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp))))
    (:"Is Not Valid"
      (Variables|0-Enlace|SetHarp (Actor|GetActorOfClass "/Game/SoulCharger/Mechanics/Harp/Blueprints/BP_Harp_SC.BP_Harp_SC_C")))))
AsSenseHarp:
(fn AsSenseHarp ()
  (bind lp (Class|BPHarpSC|GetLastPluck (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) (Utilities|Array|Length lp))
  (for i (range (Utilities|Array|Length lp))
    (bind v (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) lp i))
    (if (> v (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) i))
      (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) i v)
      (CallFunction|AsAdd :Col (Class|BPHarpSC|NoteColor :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp) :I i)))))
AsAdd:
(fn AsAdd (Col)
  (if (< (Variables|Z-Estado|GetUsed) (Utilities|Array|Length (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams)))
    (bind c (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetUsed)))
    (bind xf (Transformation|GetActorTransform))
    (CallFunction|AsStart :Comp c :T0 (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeinSeconds) :Col Col :Seed (Math|Random|RandomFloatinRange :Min 0.0 :Max 997.0))
    (CallFunction|AsPlace :Comp c :EyeL (Math|Transform|InverseTransformLocation xf (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEye)) :EmitL (Math|Transform|InverseTransformLocation xf (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmitW)))
    (Variables|Z-Estado|SetUsed (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetUsed) 1))))
AsFollow:
(fn AsFollow (Dt)
  (bind cm (Game|GetPlayerCameraManager 0))
  (Utilities|IsValid cm
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind cam (Camera|GetCameraLocation cm))
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEye (select (> (Math|Vector|Distance(Vector) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEye) cam) 300.0) cam (Math|Interpolation|VInterpTo (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEye) cam Dt (Variables|2-Envoltura|GetFollow))))
      (CallFunction|AsEmitUpdate)
      (bind xf (Transformation|GetActorTransform))
      (bind eyel (Math|Transform|InverseTransformLocation xf (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEye)))
      (bind emitl (Math|Transform|InverseTransformLocation xf (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmitW)))
      (for i (range (Variables|Z-Estado|GetUsed))
        (CallFunction|AsPlace :Comp (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStreams) i) :EyeL eyel :EmitL emitl)))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
